title: Bridging case of hypercontractivity on the Boolean cube
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, and let $p,u\in\bbr$ satisfy $1\le p\le 2\le u$. Set $\rho=\sqrt{(p-1)/(u-1)}$ and let $T_\rho$ denote the noise operator with parameter $\rho$. Then
\[
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{T_\rho f}^{\,u}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{1/u}
  \;\le\;
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\,\abs{f}^{\,p}\,\bigr]\bigr)^{1/p},
\]
where the expectations are taken with respect to the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$.
